value.rationale: A precise ecological design gap concerns the loss of temporal order when camera-trap histories are reduced to per-site counts. Unknown occupancy creates a structural zero component not covered by known-occupied availability results. The theorem proves four occasions suffice globally despite count coarsening, provides explicit feasibility and reconstruction, and gives an exact three-occasion ambiguity witness. These are natural decision-relevant identifiability boundaries for the published ecological model, beyond a textbook renaming. Finite-sample conditioning, heterogeneous sites, negative memory and field performance are explicitly not claimed.
